headline: Indian Exporters Face 8% Cost Burden Under Potential US Trade Terms
summary: The Federation of Indian Export Organisations warned that a potential bilateral trade agreement offering a 17% tariff concession may still impose an 8% additional cost burden and leave Indian exporters at a disadvantage.
why: Trade agreement terms dictate international competitiveness for export-heavy emerging economies.

impacts.name: Indian export sector
impacts.why: Higher operational cost burdens relative to regional competitors reduce export profit margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
